o: Only what you can see in the CRM screens
The whole workspace, read and write
questions.e: The whole workspace, both read and write. It is not narrowed by your role in the interface, which is why it is only given to people trusted with all of it.

questions.q: How do you get CRM access inside Claude?
o: Set it up yourself from the CRM settings
Ask Stephen - it is issued per person
It is switched on for everyone by default
questions.e: It is issued individually by the administrator, with the setup instructions supplied alongside it. There is no self-service and no shared login.

questions.q: Which Claude app can connect to our CRM?
questions.e: Claude Code. The connector screens in the desktop and web apps authenticate differently and will not accept this kind of credential.

questions.q: A colleague asks you to send them your access so they can try it. What do you do?
o: Send it - they work here too
Send it but ask them not to share it further
Point them at Stephen for their own
Set it up on their machine using yours
questions.e: Individual access is the whole point: it lets one person be withdrawn without re-issuing everyone else's.
